Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Adds conditional automatic retainer inventory scans and per-material rejected-price history. Fixes manual-stop home return, confirmed purchase totals and replenishment status layout stability.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks eight submarine salvage items, NPC sale values, and character-held gil across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, CSV export, and AutoRetainer completion reports through Discord webhooks. Use /ssit to open or /ssit settings to configure notifications.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
Changelog: Changes command to /ssit, adds manual reporting and optional client exit after successful Discord reporting.

Author: karaage
Name: Submarine Logistics Manager
Description: Use /slm to open. Manually start supply, NPC selling, or Free Destination Check in data center and world priority order. Protects ten designated items and tracks gil, inventory space, stock warnings, and failure history. After FC return, moves forward for up to two seconds. Choose Do Nothing (default), Exit Client, or Logout after the final character. Pins the active character at the top of the table. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh.
Punchline: Manage submarine supplies, NPC selling, free destinations, and automated multi-character runs.
Changelog: Adds an ACC-style completion settings panel with Do Nothing (default), Exit Client, and Logout. Existing configurations without a completion preference default to Do Nothing. Applies the selected action only to the final character and captures it at run start. Pins the active character directly below the table header, keeps it visible while scrolling or filtering, and restores the normal display after completion or cancellation. Preserves the remaining row order and actual run order.
